sidebar.gitHint: Git: backup in a repository (commit, pull, push)
sidebar.emptyLead: Keep here the scripts you use on any database: reindex a table, blocking sessions, space per table…
sidebar.emptyHelp: Each script is for one or more engines. Opening it copies it into a query on the active database, and the {params} are asked for at that moment.
sidebar.othersHint: Scripts written for engines other than {{engine}}
sidebar.imported_one: Imported {{count}} script for {{engines}}. You can change the engine by editing it.
sidebar.imported_other: Imported {{count}} scripts for {{engines}}. You can change the engine by editing them.
sidebar.exportAllTitle: Folder to export the library to
sidebar.imported_many: Imported {{count}} scripts for {{engines}}. You can change the engine by editing them.

folder.deleteConfirmScripts_one: Delete the folder “{{path}}”? Its script moves to the parent folder; it isn't deleted.
folder.deleteConfirmScripts_other: Delete the folder “{{path}}”? Its {{count}} scripts move to the parent folder; none is deleted.
folder.deleteConfirmScripts_many: Delete the folder “{{path}}”? Its {{count}} scripts move to the parent folder; none is deleted.

dialogs.engineRequired: Choose which engine it's for (or "Any SQL engine")
dialogs.appended: “{{name}}” appended to the end of the query
dialogs.textPlaceholder: The script. Use {{example}} for the values asked for when opening it, for example {{example2}}.
dialogs.paramsHint: Parameters: {table}, {schema}, {days}… are asked for when opening the script, with suggestions from the database's tables.
dialogs.dragHint: You can also drag it onto a folder.
dialogs.openHint: A copy is opened: the library doesn't change. Nothing runs until you run it.

git.title: Library in git
git.upToDate: The library was already up to date with the repo.
git.linkedPushed: {{summary}} The library was pushed to the repo.
git.committed: Changes committed. They still need to be pushed (Push).
git.useRemoteConfirm: The repo version is used: library changes that aren't in the repo are lost.
git.useLocalConfirm: The library is pushed as it is: it replaces the changes someone else made in the repo.
git.localKept: The repo now has the library's version.
git.unlinkConfirm: The library stops syncing with the repo. No scripts are deleted, neither in DBine nor in the repo.
git.noGit: git wasn't found on this machine
git.noGitHelp: Install it from git-scm.com (on macOS it also comes with the Command Line Tools) and reopen this window.
git.help: Keep the library in a git repository (GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps…) as a backup or to share it.
git.helpFiles: Each script is stored as a file in its folder, with its language's extension: {sql}, {js} (MongoDB), {json}, {cql}, {redis}, {flux} or {cypher}.
git.credentialsHelp: DBine uses the installed git with your credentials (SSH or git's credential manager): it doesn't store passwords or tokens. When linking, it brings in the scripts the repo already has and pushes the library's.
